sections.en:
We've discovered the ruins of an ancient city on [From.Planet.GetName]. Given its size and scale, this was likely the capital or central administrative hub of a major space-faring civilization.

A full excavation will be necessary to properly determine its origin.

texts.zh:
宏伟的圣殿与损毁的神庙点缀在首都之上。而更深入的探索揭示出这个文明早在五十多万年前就被毁灭了。

根据几幅保存得相当完好的壁画被发现，原住民似乎在生物学上接近鸟类。对他们语言的初步音译表明，他们称自己为“克拉祖拉”。
texts.en:
Grand sanctums and ruined temples dot the landscape of the capital. A deeper exploration has revealed that this civilization was destroyed more than half a million years ago.

Based on the discovery of several remarkably well-preserved murals, the inhabitants appeared to be avian in biology. A rough transliteration of their language indicates they called themselves the Krazura.

texts.zh:
进一步的挖掘带来了一个惊人的发现：一个如此巨大的洞穴，足以容纳这个行星上较小的一些山脉。尽管它的建筑规模令人敬畏，但这个“大厅”却没有明显的功能，只有一个出入口。

这个大致呈球形的大厅内壁上遗留有强力的维度扭曲的证据；可以合理得出结论，这个密室是围绕虫洞或其他亚空间传送门的。

更重要的是，大殿外蚀刻的一幅壁画提供了一个令人难以置信的发现：这颗行星不是别的正是斯卡拉维德，是著名的舰队司令斯克兰德·夏普比克的祖先的居住地！
texts.en:
Further excavation has resulted in a startling discovery: a chamber so massive it could house one of the planet's smaller mountains. Despite the awesome scale of its construction, this 'Grand Hall' serves no apparent function, with only a single means of entrance and egress.

Roughly spherical, the chamber's walls show strong evidence of dimensional warping; it is reasonable to conclude that the chamber was built around a wormhole or some other subspace portal.

What's more, a mural etched just outside the Hall provided an incredible discovery: this planet is none other than Skravird, ancestral home of the famous Admiral Skrand Sharpbeak!

texts.zh:
进一步的挖掘带来了一个惊人的发现：一个如此巨大的洞穴，足以容纳这个行星上较小的一些山脉。尽管它的建筑规模令人敬畏，但这个“大厅”却没有明显的功能，只有一个出入口。

这个大致呈球形的大厅内壁上遗留有强力的维度扭曲的证据；可以合理得出结论，这个密室是围绕虫洞或其他亚空间传送门的。

这座大厅外蚀刻的壁画表明这颗行星曾经被称为斯卡拉维德。
texts.en:
Further excavation has resulted in a startling discovery: a chamber so massive it could house one of the planet's smaller mountains. Despite the awesome scale of its construction, this 'Grand Hall' serves no apparent function, with only a single means of entrance and egress.

Roughly spherical, the chamber's walls show strong evidence of dimensional warping; it is reasonable to conclude that the chamber was built around a wormhole or some other subspace portal.

A mural etched just outside the Hall indicates this planet was once called Skravird.

texts.zh:
你找到了斯卡拉维德。我本以为我永远地失去了家园。

有机会我会把我的爪子插入它的土里，感受着温暖的南风吹拂我的羽毛... 你为我和我的人民所做的一切都无法估量。

我的身体和心灵都感到焕然一新。我对你心怀感激。
texts.en:
You have found Skravird. I thought my home lost forever.

To have the chance to set my talons into its ground, to feel the warm south wind blowing through my feathers... What you have done for me and for my people is beyond measure.

I am refreshed, in body and mind. You have my gratitude.

texts.zh:
我们已经确定了这个克拉祖拉并非来自我们维度。他们通过某种类型的传送门抵达这里，发现自己漂流到一个陌生的外星星系中。很久以后，他们在到达的地点周围建造了这个大厅。

仅存的几份记录表明，他们认为自己是伟大而神秘力量的仲裁者。他们的最高领袖，被称为“亚库拉”，被认为是一种独立的个体，每一代都会转移到一个新的身体里。

在大厅下面，我们挖出了几位统治者的遗骸。有趣的是，最早的统治者与后面的统治者有着不同的基因结构。似乎是前往这个宇宙的旅程的影响了克拉祖拉的DNA，导致“复”眼的出现。
texts.en:
We have established that the Krazura were not native to our dimension. Arriving through a portal of some kind, they found themselves adrift in a strange and alien galaxy. Much later, the Grand Hall was built around their arrival site.

The few remaining records indicate they viewed themselves as arbiters of great and mystical power. Their supreme leader, known as the 'Yakura', was believed to be a single individual, reincarnating into a new body with each generation.

Beneath the Grand Hall, we unearthed the remains of several such rulers. Interestingly, the earliest possessed a different genetic structure from those that followed. It seems the journey to this universe impacted the Krazura's very DNA, resulting in the emergence of a 'double' set of eyes.

texts.zh:
克拉祖拉最初是我们宇宙中的难民。然而，在大殿附近发现的记录表明，他们迅速建立起了一个强大的星际帝国。他们的人民在多个世代的时间里保持着繁荣昌盛。亚库拉的能力和至高无上的地位毋庸置疑。然后，“威胁”出现了。

这个无名的敌人和他们以前遇到的敌人都不一样，似乎一心要毁灭他们。亚库拉这个最伟大的圣贤们在这强大的威胁面前无能为力，他们强大的才能变得毫无用处。
texts.en:
The Krazura started out as refugees in our universe. Nevertheless, records discovered near the Grand Hall show that they quickly established themselves as a powerful interstellar empire. For many generations they enjoyed a Golden Age. Their people prospered, and the ability and supremacy of the Yakura went unquestioned. Then the Menace appeared.

A foe unlike any they had encountered before, this nameless enemy seemed obsessed with their destruction. The Krazura's greatest sages stood powerless before the indomitable threat, their mighty magic rendered useless.

texts.zh:
我们发现了一批记录，为了解克拉祖拉的命运提供了线索。

指挥他们海军旗舰的是一位传奇的舰队司令，他是他人民的伟大英雄。在被外星威胁取得最后的胜利之前，他和他的船员们被派遣执行了最后且大胆的任务。为了绕过敌人，他们进入了一个未经测试的星门。自此，这艘船和它的船员们便再也没有了任何音讯。

这中间发生了什么仍然是一个谜。这艘舰船是否仍有存在可能？
texts.en:
We have uncovered a cache of records that offer clues as to the fate of the Krazura.

Commanding their navy's flagship was a legendary Admiral, a great hero of his people. Before the alien Menace could achieve a final victory, he and his crew were sent on a last, daring mission. In a bid to outflank the enemy, they entered an untested Gateway. The ship and its crew were never heard from again.

What happened remains a mystery. Is it possible that this ship is still out there?

texts.zh:
我们发现了一批记录，为了解克拉祖拉的命运提供了线索。

为了大胆地绕过敌人，亚库拉命令旗舰穿过未经测试的星门。舰队司令正是传奇的斯克兰德·夏普比克。

他和他的船员们继承了一项非凡的遗产。无论斯克兰德是否愿意接受这个头衔，他的人民现在将他视为亚库拉。
texts.en:
We have uncovered a cache of records that offer clues as to the fate of the Krazura.

In a daring bid to outflank the enemy, the Yakura ordered the flagship to enter an untested Gateway. In command was the legendary Admiral Skrand Sharpbeak.

He and his crew are the inheritors of a remarkable legacy. Whether Skrand wishes to accept the title or not, his people now look to him as Yakura.
